quality_guards: Vehicle-paint exposure risk depends on paint chemistry, spraying method, booth extraction, clearance time, RPE condition, work practices and worker susceptibility.
HSE motor-vehicle-paint evidence is process-, product-, booth-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level asthma probability.
Tyre-inflation risk depends on tyre size, pressure, damage, wheel design, seating, restraint, operator position and competence.
HSE tyre evidence is wheel-, tyre-, pressure-, task-, operator- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level explosion probability.
Warehouse risk depends on stock type, racking design, loading, traffic routes, handling methods, worker competence, maintenance and emergency planning.
HSE warehouse evidence is site-, stock-, racking-, vehicle-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Powered-gate risk depends on geometry, force, speed, sensors, foundations, weather, maintenance, users and emergency-release arrangements.
HSE powered-gate evidence is product-, installation-, location-, user-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Cryptosporidiosis risk depends on parasite species, water treatment, animal or person contact, hygiene, immunity, exposure route and timing.
UKHSA Cryptosporidium evidence is organism-, water-, animal-, person-, outbreak- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
STEC risk depends on strain, food or water source, animal contact, infectious dose, hygiene, host factors and response timing.
UKHSA STEC evidence is strain-, food-, animal-, water-, person-, outbreak- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Hepatitis-C risk depends on blood exposure, equipment sharing, procedure safety, testing history, treatment access and individual factors.
UKHSA hepatitis-C evidence is exposure-, person-, laboratory-, treatment-, population- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Baby-sleep-product risk depends on product softness, shape, intended age, sleep-space use, supervision, airway position and thermal conditions.
OPSS baby-sleep-pillow evidence is product-, design-, infant-, use-, retailer- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fatality probability.
GNSS-interference risk depends on location, signal environment, aircraft systems, route, redundancy, crew procedures and reporting.
CAA GNSS evidence is signal-, region-, aircraft-, operator-, event- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level aviation-incident probability.
Fishing-vessel stability risk depends on hull, loading, freeboard, centre of gravity, gear, liquids, weather, sea state and operation.
MCA stability evidence is vessel-, loading-, gear-, sea-state-, crew- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level capsize probability.
